note: cookie consent banner -- renders: consent title, consent description text, policy links, 'Manage preferences' / 'Reject all' / 'Accept all' buttons, language selector options
site masthead -- renders: subscribe/log-in links, sections button, search button, section label, account link, NYT logo link
Arts section header -- renders: 'Arts' heading and fixed sub-section navigation links (Art & Design, Books, Dance, etc.)
tab navigation controls -- renders: fixed page tab labels for switching stream views
site index label -- renders: 'Site Index' heading
site footer -- renders: company heading, subscription link, fixed footer navigation links (News, Opinion, Arts, Living, More, etc.), copyright line
article highlights section -- renders: 'Highlights' heading and operator-authored article cards (titles, summaries, bylines, images, captions) selected by NYT editorial staff
article stream -- renders: operator-authored article cards (titles, summaries, bylines, images) and fixed pagination navigation links; no user-generated content present
